avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: P-glycoprotein inducer may reduce methylnaltrexone bioavailability and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if needed

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: P-glycoprotein inhibitor may theoretically increase methylnaltrexone levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects (nausea, diarrhea); limit consumption

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance gastrointestinal motility effects; additive GI stimulation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor bowel function; separate administration timing if possible

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay gastric emptying and affect subcutaneous absorption timing
caution_foods.action: No dietary restriction needed; effects are minor with parenteral administration

monitoring_notes: Methylnaltrexone has minimal drug interactions due to lack of hepatic metabolism and limited CYP450 involvement. Monitor renal function as primary elimination route; adjust dose in severe renal impairment. No clinically significant food interactions reported.
